listen_addr.description: IPv4 address the Telnet daemon listens on. Use 0.0.0.0 for all interfaces.

listen_port.description: TCP port for incoming Telnet connections.

max_connections.description: Maximum number of simultaneous client connections allowed.

timeout_seconds.description: Idle connection timeout in seconds. After this, the session terminates.

debug.description: Enable verbose debug logging? Set to 'true' for troubleshooting.

loglevel.description: Minimum log level: none, info, warn, error, debug.

logfile.description: Path to log file. Leave blank to use system syslog instead.

auth_required.description: Require authentication before allowing Telnet access.

auth_db.description: Path to the user database file (used when authentication is required).

allowed_macs.description: List of allowed MAC addresses and their associated usernames and descriptions.

username.description: Username assigned to this MAC (for login)

description.description: Optional human-readable description of the device/user

denied_macs.description: List of MAC addresses to explicitly deny (optional).

tty_device.description: Optional TTY device to bind the session to (e.g., /dev/ttys000). Leave blank for auto-selection.

banner_file.description: Path to a file whose contents will be displayed as the login banner.

enable_web_interface.description: Enable the optional web-based management interface (requires mactelnet-web plugin).

web_addr.description: IP address for the web management interface to bind to.

web_port.description: Port for the web management interface.

web_ssl_cert.description: Path to SSL certificate for the web interface (required if web SSL enabled).

web_ssl_key.description: Path to SSL private key for the web interface (required if web SSL enabled).

web_ssl.description: Enable HTTPS for the web interface (recommended for security).
